title: A family kitchen, first and always
intro: Chaska means the taste you keep coming back for. It is what this food has meant to our family for generations.

owner.title: Ronika Singh Bhatia
paragraphs: Ronika grew up in a kitchen where recipes were never written down. They were watched, tasted and corrected, and passed from one generation to the next.
She started Chaska in Frisco to serve that food the way it is served at home: family style, meant to be shared.

family.title: Snoopy, our sous chef
paragraphs: The whole family is here, including Snoopy, our shih tzu and honorary sous chef.

quote.text: “If it doesn’t taste like home, it doesn’t leave my kitchen.”
